independent_replication: None found in this or the 2026-09-28 gap-search round.

claim: Negative-evidence check: dual-momentum/relative-strength rotation strategies suffer whipsaw losses in choppy markets and lag V-shaped recoveries (2015 -6.2% example; 2009 recovery-lag example).
quote: When prices move back and forth without direction, signals whipsaw and the strategy ends up buying and selling at the wrong time. 2015 was the clearest example: the strategy lost 6.2% despite global equities being broadly flat.
limitations: Retrieved via WebSearch indexed snippet, not an independent full-page WebFetch in this session; general critique of the relative-strength/dual-momentum family, not specific to any of this iteration's six pairs.
independent_replication: n/a -- general practitioner commentary, not an empirical claim being reused as a number.
impact_on_spec: Negative-evidence check for the pair-switch mechanism family: whipsaw in choppy markets and lag after V-shaped recoveries are exactly the failure mode the stress window (2016-05-02..2023-09-15, including 2020's COVID V-shaped recovery) is designed to expose, and the economic reason the STATIC5050 placebo family is preregistered alongside every PAIR candidate.
